        --gray-100: #fafbfc;

        /* Surface */
        --surface: #FFFFFF;

        /* Status Colors (from Brand Guide) */
        --success: #16a34a;
        --warning: #D26F0D;
        --danger: #dc2626;
        --info: #187FCC;
        --purple: #7c3aed;

        /* Design Tokens - Compact (from Brand Guide) */
        --radius-xs: 8px;
        --radius-sm: 10px;
        --radius-md: 14px;
        --radius-lg: 18px;
        --radius-xl: 24px;

        /* Shadows (from Brand Guide) */
        --shadow-subtle: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
        --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
        --shadow-md: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
        --shadow-lg: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);

        /* ============================================================
           Velzon CSS Variable Overrides — Replace purple with SDF Blue
           These get overridden by layout.js, so we also fix via script
        ============================================================ */
        --vz-primary: #187FCC !important;
        --vz-primary-rgb: 24,127,204 !important;
        --vz-header-bg: #fff !important;
        --vz-header-border: rgba(0,0,0,0.06) !important;
        --vz-header-item-bg: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.08) !important;
        --vz-header-item-color: #475569 !important;
        --vz-header-item-sub-color: #475569 !important;
        --vz-topbar-user-bg: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.08) !important;
        --vz-topbar-search-bg: #f3f5f7 !important;
        --vz-link-color: #187FCC !important;
        --vz-link-color-rgb: 24,127,204 !important;
        --vz-link-hover-color: #1570b8 !important;
        --vz-link-hover-color-rgb: 21,112,184 !important;
        --vz-topnav-item-active-color: #187FCC !important;
        --vz-topnav-bg: #187FCC !important;
        --vz-vertical-menu-item-active-color: #187FCC !important;
        --vz-vertical-menu-item-hover-color: #187FCC !important;
        --vz-vertical-menu-item-active-bg: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.15) !important;
        --vz-vertical-menu-item-bg: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.15) !important;
        --vz-vertical-menu-sub-item-active-color: #187FCC !important;
        --vz-vertical-menu-sub-item-hover-color: #187FCC !important;
        --vz-focus-ring-color: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.25) !important;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Typography (Arabic)
    ============================================================ */
    * ,
    .h1, .h2, .h3, .h4, .h5, .h6,
    h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
        font-family: 'Rubik', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    }
    
/* ============================================================
   MEAL & Risk Pages — Unified Typography & Components
============================================================ */
    .risk-card, .risk-preview, .risk-kpi-card, .risk-kpi-item,
    .risk-lib-item, .risk-stat-card, .incident-card,
    .risk-sidebar-item, .risk-project-item,
    .wizard-card, .risk-form-input, .risk-form-label,
    .risk-badge, .risk-kpi-label, .risk-kpi-value,
    .form-input, .upload-zone, .step-item,
    .meal-ph, .meal-ph-tab, .md-proj, .md-stat {
        font-family: 'Rubik', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    }

    /* Risk page headings */
    .risk-card h1, .risk-card h2, .risk-card h3, .risk-card h4, .risk-card h5, .risk-card h6,
    .wizard-card h1, .wizard-card h2, .wizard-card h3, .wizard-card h4, .wizard-card h5, .wizard-card h6 {
        font-family: 'Rubik', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    }

    /* Risk form inputs match MEAL styling */
    .risk-form-input, .wizard-card .form-input {
        font-family: 'Rubik', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
        border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    /* Risk badges consistent border-radius */
    .risk-badge, .risk-badge-critical, .risk-badge-high, .risk-badge-moderate, .risk-badge-low {
        border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
        font-family: 'Rubik', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    }

    /* Risk KPI values match MEAL dashboard style */
    .risk-kpi-value {
        font-family: 'Rubik', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
        letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

/* ============================================================
   Body & Background
============================================================ */
    body {
        background: var(--gray-100);
        color: var(--gray-900);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Top Bar / Header — Override ALL Velzon defaults
    ============================================================ */
    #page-topbar {
        background-color: #fff !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] #page-topbar,
    body[data-topbar="dark"] .ishorizontal-topbar,
    body[data-topbar="dark"] .isvertical-topbar,
    body[data-topbar="colored"] .ishorizontal-topbar,
    body[data-topbar="colored"] .isvertical-topbar,
    body[data-layout="horizontal"][data-topbar="dark"] .ishorizontal-topbar,
    body[data-layout="horizontal"][data-topbar="colored"] .ishorizontal-topbar {
        background-color: #fff !important;
    }

    .navbar-header {
        background-color: #fff !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .navbar-header .dropdown.show .header-item {
        background-color: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.08) !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .header-item {
        fill: var(--gray-700) !important;
    }
    body[data-topbar="dark"] .header-item i {
        color: var(--gray-700) !important;
    }
    body[data-topbar="dark"] .header-item span {
        color: var(--gray-700) !important;
    }
    body[data-topbar="dark"] .header-item:hover {
        fill: var(--brand-primary) !important;
    }
    body[data-topbar="dark"] .header-item:hover i {
        color: var(--brand-primary) !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .header-profile-user {
        border-color: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.25) !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .user-name {
        color: var(--gray-900) !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .user-sub-title {
        color: var(--gray-500) !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .noti-icon i {
        color: var(--gray-700) !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .app-search .form-control {
        background-color: var(--gray-100) !important;
        color: var(--gray-900) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06) !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .app-search span,
    body[data-topbar="dark"] .app-search input.form-control::-webkit-input-placeholder {
        color: var(--gray-500) !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .breadcrumb-item > a {
        color: var(--brand-primary) !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .breadcrumb-item.active {
        color: var(--gray-500) !important;
    }

    body[data-topbar="dark"] .page-title {
        color: var(--gray-900) !important;
    }

    @media (max-width: 991.98px) {
        body[data-topbar="dark"] .ishorizontal-topbar .navbar-header .navbar-brand-box,
        body[data-topbar="dark"] .isvertical-topbar .navbar-header .navbar-brand-box {
            background-color: #fff !important;
        }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Navbar / Sidebar — Brand gradient (Blue → Teal)
    ============================================================ */
    /* Vertical sidebar — clean dark blue */
    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu {
        background: #1e293b !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .sidebar-background {
        background: #1e293b !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-link {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-link:hover {
        color: #fff !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-link.active {
        color: #fff !important;
        background: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.2) !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .menu-title {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) !important;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-size: 11px !important;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-sm .nav-link {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-sm .nav-link:hover,
    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-sm .nav-link.active {
        color: #fff !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-brand-box {
        background: #1e293b !important;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Horizontal Navigation — Solid Blue
    ============================================================ */
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu {
        background: #187FCC !important;
        border: none !important;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.3) !important;
    }

    [data-layout="horizontal"] .sidebar-background {
        background: #187FCC !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
    }

    /* ALL nav links in horizontal mode — white text */
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav > li > a.nav-link,
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .nav-link.menu-link,
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-link,
    [data-layout="horizontal"] #navbar-nav > li > a {
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: 500 !important;
    }

    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav > li > a.nav-link:hover,
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .nav-link.menu-link:hover {
        color: #fff !important;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
        border-radius: 6px;
    }

    /* Menu icons in horizontal — white */
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .nav-link i,
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .nav-link .nav-icon {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) !important;
    }

    /* Arrow indicators in horizontal */
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .menu-link::after {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) !important;
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) !important;
    }

    /* Menu title in horizontal */
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .menu-title {
        display: none !important;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Dropdown / Submenu — Horizontal mode (white popup)
    ============================================================ */
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .menu-dropdown,
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .menu-dropdown,
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .dropdown-menu {
        background-color: #fff !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08) !important;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12) !important;
        z-index: 1050 !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
    }

    [data-layout="horizontal"] .menu-dropdown .nav-link,
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .menu-dropdown .nav-link {
        color: var(--gray-700) !important;
        background-color: transparent !important;
        font-weight: 400 !important;
    }

    [data-layout="horizontal"] .menu-dropdown .nav-link:hover,
    [data-layout="horizontal"] .navbar-menu .menu-dropdown .nav-link:hover {
        color: var(--brand-primary) !important;
        background-color: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.06) !important;
    }

    [data-layout="horizontal"] .menu-dropdown .nav-link.active {
        color: var(--brand-primary) !important;
        background-color: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.1) !important;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Dropdown / Submenu — Vertical mode (dark sidebar submenus)
    ============================================================ */
    [data-layout="vertical"] .menu-dropdown,
    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .menu-dropdown {
        background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) !important;
        border: none !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .menu-dropdown .nav-link,
    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .menu-dropdown .nav-link,
    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-sm .nav-link {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) !important;
        background-color: transparent !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .menu-dropdown .nav-link:hover,
    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .menu-dropdown .nav-link:hover,
    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-sm .nav-link:hover {
        color: #fff !important;
    }

    [data-layout="vertical"] .menu-dropdown .nav-link.active,
    [data-layout="vertical"] .navbar-menu .navbar-nav .nav-sm .nav-link.active {
        color: #fff !important;
    }

    /* General dropdown-menu (user dropdown etc.) */
    .dropdown-menu {
        background-color: #fff !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08) !important;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12) !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Cards
    ============================================================ */
    .card {
        background: var(--surface);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        -webkit-user-select: text !important;
        user-select: text !important;
    }

    .card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .card > .card-header {
        background: transparent;
        border-bottom: 0;
        padding-top: 14px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .card::before,
    .card::after {
        content: none !important;
    }

    .card .card-title {
        color: var(--gray-900);
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: .2px;
    }

    .card .top-strip {
        display: block;
        height: 4px;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #187FCC, #1CB7B3);
        border-top-left-radius: inherit;
        border-top-right-radius: inherit;
    }

    /* Card selectability fix */
    .card,
    .card * {
        -webkit-user-select: text !important;
        -moz-user-select: text !important;
        user-select: text !important;
        pointer-events: auto;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Stat Cards
    ============================================================ */
    .stat-card {
        padding: 12px 14px;
    }

    .stat-card .value {
        font-size: 24px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--gray-900);
        line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .stat-card .label {
        font-size: 13px;
        color: var(--gray-700);
    }

    .stat-card .badge-dot {
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        display: inline-block;
        margin-inline-end: 8px;
        background: var(--brand-warm);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Activity Cards
    ============================================================ */
    .activity-card {
        padding: 14px 16px 12px;
        display: flex;
        gap: 12px;
        align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .activity-card .avatar {
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .activity-card .meta {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .activity-card .text {
        color: var(--gray-900);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Form Controls
    ============================================================ */
    .form-control,
    .form-select,
    textarea.form-control {
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
        padding: 8px 14px;
        color: var(--gray-900);
        box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(2,6,23,.02) inset;
        transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s, background-color .2s;
    }

    .form-control:hover,
    .form-select:hover {
        border-color: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.45);
    }

    .form-control:focus,
    .form-select:focus {
        background: #fff;
        border-color: var(--brand-accent);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(28, 183, 179, 0.15);
        outline: none;
    }

    .form-control:disabled,
    .form-select:disabled,
    .form-control[readonly] {
        background: #F8FAFC;
        color: #94A3B8;
        border-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
        opacity: .9;
    }

    .form-control::placeholder {
        color: #cbd5e1;
    }

    textarea.form-control {
        min-height: 120px;
        resize: vertical;
    }

    /* Input Groups */
    .input-group .form-control {
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .input-group-text {
        background: var(--gray-100);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
        color: var(--gray-700);
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    /* Floating Labels */
    .form-floating > .form-control,
    .form-floating > .form-select {
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .form-floating > label {
        color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    /* Validation */
    .is-valid.form-control {
        border-color: var(--success);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(22, 163, 74, .18);
    }

    .is-invalid.form-control {
        border-color: var(--danger);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(220, 38, 38, .16);
    }

    /* Checkboxes & Radios */
    .form-check-input {
        width: 1.1rem;
        height: 1.1rem;
        border-radius: .45rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,.25);
        accent-color: var(--brand-primary);
    }

    .form-check-input:focus {
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(28, 183, 179, 0.15);
        border-color: var(--brand-accent);
    }

    /* Switches */
    .form-switch .form-check-input {
        width: 2.2rem;
        height: 1.2rem;
        border-radius: 1rem;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Buttons
    ============================================================ */
    .btn {
        border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: .1px;
        padding: 7px 14px;
        font-size: 13px;
        transition: transform .08s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, background-color .2s;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
    }

    .btn:active {
        transform: translateY(1px);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(2,6,23,.10);
    }

    /* Button Sizes */
    .btn-sm {
        padding: 5px 10px;
        font-size: 12px;
        border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
    }

    .btn-lg {
        padding: 10px 16px;
        border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    /* Primary Button — Blue gradient */
    .btn-primary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-primary) 0%, var(--brand-accent) 100%);
        border: none;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1570b8 0%, #19a5a1 100%);
    }

    /* Accent Button */
    .btn-accent {
        background: var(--brand-accent);
        border-color: var(--brand-accent);
        color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-accent:hover {
        background: #19a5a1;
        border-color: #19a5a1;
    }

    /* Warm Button */
    .btn-warm {
        background: var(--brand-warm);
        border-color: var(--brand-warm);
        color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-warm:hover {
        background: #b85f0b;
        border-color: #b85f0b;
    }

    /* Status Buttons */
    .btn-success { background: var(--success); border-color: var(--success); }
    .btn-danger { background: var(--danger); border-color: var(--danger); }
    .btn-warning { background: var(--warning); border-color: var(--warning); color: #fff; }

    /* Outline Button */
    .btn-outline-primary {
        color: var(--brand-primary);
        border-color: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.55);
        background: transparent;
    }

    .btn-outline-primary:hover {
        background: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.08);
        border-color: var(--brand-primary);
        color: var(--brand-primary);
    }

    /* Ghost Button */
    .btn-ghost {
        background: rgba(2,6,23,.04);
        border: 1px solid rgba(2,6,23,.06);
        color: var(--gray-900);
        box-shadow: none;
    }

    .btn-ghost:hover {
        background: rgba(2,6,23,.06);
    }

    /* Soft Buttons */
    .btn-soft-primary {
        background: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.10);
        color: #0B4D88;
        border: 1px solid rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.18);
    }

    .btn-soft-primary:hover {
        background: rgba(24, 127, 204, 0.18);
    }

    .btn-soft-info {
        background: rgba(28, 183, 179, 0.1);
        color: var(--brand-accent);
        border: none;
    }

    .btn-soft-info:hover {
        background: rgba(28, 183, 179, 0.2);
        color: var(--brand-accent);
    }

    /* Icon Button */
    .btn-icon {
        padding: 8px;
        width: 38px;
        height: 38px;
        display: inline-grid;
        place-items: center;
        border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    /* Loading State */
    .btn[aria-busy="true"] {
        position: relative;
        pointer-events: none;
        opacity: .85;
    }

    .btn[aria-busy="true"]::after {
        content: "";
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);
        border-top-color: rgba(255,255,255,1);
        position: absolute;
        inset-inline-end: 12px;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        animation: btn-spin .8s linear infinite;
    }

    @keyframes btn-spin {
        to { transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(360deg); }
    }

    /* Card Buttons - no shadow */
    .card .btn {
        box-shadow: none;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       GridJS Table
    ============================================================ */
    .gridjs-head,
    .gridjs-body,
    .gridjs-tr,
    .gridjs-th {
        text-align: right;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Icons Fix
    ============================================================ */
    .mdi:before {
        font-family: "Material Design Icons" !important;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       RTL Helpers
    ============================================================ */
    [dir="rtl"] .me-2 {
        margin-left: .5rem;
        margin-right: 0 !important;
    }

    [dir="rtl"] .btn .me-2 {
        margin-left: .5rem;
        margin-right: 0 !important;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       Mobile Responsive
    ============================================================ */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .sidebar-background {
            background: #1e293b !important;
            opacity: 1 !important;
        }

        .search-box {
            display: none !important;
        }
    }

    .search-box .form-control {
        padding-right: 40px;
        color: black;
    }

    /* Force show dark logo on white topbar */
    .horizontal-logo .logo-dark {
        display: inline-block !important;
    }
    .horizontal-logo .logo-light {
        display: none !important;
    }

        @keyframes gridShift { 0% { transform: translate(0,0); } 100% { transform: translate(80px,80px); } }

        @keyframes fadeUp {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); }
            to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        /* ===== TOP BAR ===== */
        .top-bar {
            position: relative; z-index: 10;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 1.1rem 2.5rem;
        }
        .top-bar-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
        .top-bar-brand img { height: 36px; width: auto; }
        .top-bar-brand-text { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.66); font-size: 0.78rem; padding-right: 0.75rem; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
        .top-bar-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
        .user-chip {
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
            background: var(--glass); border: 1px solid var(--glass-brd);
            border-radius: 30px; padding: 4px 14px 4px 5px;
        }
        .user-avatar {
            width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sdf-orange), var(--sdf-amber));
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-family: 'Alexandria', 'Rubik', sans-serif;
        }
        .user-chip span { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; }
        .btn-topbar {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 0.76rem; font-family: 'Rubik', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease; text-decoration: none;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
        }
        .btn-topbar:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); text-decoration: none; }
        .btn-login-topbar {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sdf-orange), var(--sdf-amber));
            border: none; color: #fff; padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;
            font-family: 'Rubik', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease; text-decoration: none;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255,152,51,0.25);
        }
        .btn-login-topbar:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(255,152,51,0.35); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; }

        /* ===============================
           AUTHENTICATED HUB
           =============================== */
        .main-content {
            position: relative; z-index: 5;
            flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            padding: 0.5rem 3rem 1rem;
        }
        .hub-shell { max-width: 1080px; width: 100%; }

        /* --- Hero greeting --- */
        .hub-hero {
            display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
            opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.6s ease 0.05s forwards;
        }
        .hub-hero-greet {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--sdf-amber); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500;
            margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
        }
        .hub-hero-greet i { font-size: 1rem; }
        .hub-hero h1 {
            font-family: 'Alexandria', 'Rubik', sans-serif;
            color: var(--ink-95); font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .hub-hero h1 span { color: var(--sdf-orange); }
        .hub-hero-meta { text-align: left; }
        .hub-hero-date {
            color: var(--ink-40); font-size: 0.78rem;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
            background: var(--glass); border: 1px solid var(--glass-brd);
            padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 20px;
        }

        /* ===============================
           NEWS TICKER — شريط الأخبار
           ===============================
           لا marquee أفقي: النصّ المتحرّك أفقياً يصعب لحاقه بالعربية، ولا يمكن
           النقر على هدف يتحرّك، ويتعذّر إيقافه لمن يحتاج. البديل سطر ثابت
           المكان يتبدّل محتواه رأسياً كل 6 ثوانٍ، ويتوقّف عند التحويم أو التركيز. */
        .news-ticker {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem;
            width: 100%; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            padding: 0.7rem 1.1rem;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
            border-radius: 14px;
            cursor: pointer; text-align: right;
            font-family: 'Rubik', Arial, sans-serif;
            transition: background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
            opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.6s ease 0.1s forwards;
            position: relative; overflow: hidden;
        }
        .news-ticker:hover, .news-ticker:focus-visible {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
        }
        .news-ticker:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sdf-amber); outline-offset: 2px; }
        .nt-label {
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-shrink: 0;
            color: var(--sdf-amber); font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600;
            padding-left: 0.85rem; border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
        }
        .nt-label i { font-size: 0.95rem; }
        .nt-viewport { flex: 1; min-width: 0; position: relative; height: 22px; }
        .nt-item {
            position: absolute; inset: 0;
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
            opacity: 0; transform: translateY(100%);
            transition: opacity 0.45s ease, transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .nt-item.is-active { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .nt-item.is-out { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-100%); }
        .nt-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .nt-title {
            color: var(--ink-95); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500;
            white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        .nt-type { color: var(--ink-40); font-size: 0.72rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .nt-ago  { color: var(--ink-30); font-size: 0.7rem; flex-shrink: 0; margin-right: auto; padding-right: 0.6rem; }
        .nt-new {
            flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
            background: rgba(255,152,51,0.16); border: 1px solid rgba(255,152,51,0.3);
            color: #ffc78a; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600;
            padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px;
        }
        .nt-new-dot {
            width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sdf-orange);
            animation: ntPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes ntPulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }
        .nt-pips { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .nt-pip {
            width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); transition: background 0.3s, width 0.3s;
        }
        .nt-pip.is-active { background: var(--sdf-amber); width: 14px; border-radius: 3px; }
        .nt-caret { color: var(--ink-30); font-size: 1.1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .news-ticker.is-empty { cursor: default; }

        /* --- Updates drawer --- */
        .nd-backdrop {
            position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1200;
            background: rgba(6,15,20,0.55);
            backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
            opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }
        .nd-backdrop.is-open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
        .news-drawer {
            position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 1201;
            width: 400px; max-width: 92vw;
            background: linear-gradient(170deg, #122733 0%, #16303f 100%);
            border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            box-shadow: -20px 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; direction: rtl;
        }
        .news-drawer.is-open { transform: translateX(0); }
        .nd-head {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
            padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
        }
        .nd-head h4 {
            font-family: 'Alexandria','Rubik',sans-serif;
            color: var(--ink-95); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0;
        }
        .nd-head-count {
            background: rgba(255,152,51,0.16); color: #ffc78a;
            font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px;
        }
        .nd-close {
            margin-right: auto; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: var(--ink-60);
            width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.1rem; transition: all 0.25s ease;
        }
        .nd-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color: #fff; }
        .nd-list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0.75rem; }
        .nd-card {
            display: block; text-decoration: none;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.045);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
            border-right: 3px solid var(--nd-accent, #64748B);
            border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.9rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
        }
        .nd-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); text-decoration: none; }
        .nd-card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
        .nd-card-type {
            font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 6px;
            /* اسم المشروع قد يكون طويلاً جداً فيبتلع سطر الترويسة كاملاً */
            max-width: 62%; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        .nd-card-ago { color: var(--ink-30); font-size: 0.68rem; margin-right: auto; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .nd-card h5 {
            color: var(--ink-95); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 0.3rem; line-height: 1.5;
            display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;
        }
        .nd-card p {
            color: var(--ink-40); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0;
            display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;
        }
        .nd-card-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.55rem; }
        .nd-card-author { color: var(--ink-30); font-size: 0.7rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
        .nd-card-author img { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; }
        .nd-unread-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sdf-orange); flex-shrink: 0; }
        .nd-foot { padding: 0.85rem 1.25rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
        .nd-foot a {
            display: block; text-align: center; text-decoration: none;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            color: var(--ink-60); font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 9px; border-radius: 9px;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
        }
        .nd-foot a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.13); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; }
        .nd-empty { text-align: center; padding: 3rem 1.5rem; color: var(--ink-30); }
        .nd-empty i { font-size: 2.4rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; opacity: 0.6; }
        .nd-empty p { font-size: 0.82rem; }

        /* --- «يلا راديو»: صفّ واحد هادئ بأسلوب بطاقة بلبل ---
           الصوت في نافذة /radio المنفصلة كي لا يتوقف عند التنقّل؛ هذه ريموت فقط.
           الموجة وأدوات الصوت لا تظهر إلا أثناء البثّ حتى لا تزدحم الصفحة. */
        .rc {
            --teal: #1CB7B3; --teal2: #57D3D0; --on-teal: #06231F; --idle: #2A3A5A;
            margin-top: 0.9rem; padding: 0.9rem 1rem; border-radius: 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28,183,179,0.13), rgba(24,24,24,0.5));
            border: 1px solid rgba(28,183,179,0.24);
            transition: border-color 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }
        .rc.is-on { border-color: rgba(28,183,179,0.45); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(28,183,179,0.14); }
        .rc input[type=range] { accent-color: var(--teal); }
        .rc-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; }
        .rc-tile {
            --punch: 0; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; background: #181818;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--teal);
            transform: scale(calc(1 + var(--punch) * 0.05));
            box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(28,183,179,0.22);
        }
        .rc.is-muted .rc-tile { color: var(--idle); }
        .rc-tile svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
        .rc-info { min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.15rem; }
        .rc-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-95); }
        .rc-title i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #6F7F98; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .rc.is-on .rc-title i { background: #dc2626; animation: rcPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
        @keyframes rcPulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: .45; transform: scale(.82); } }
        .rc-state { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--ink-40); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
        .rc-play {
            width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; border: 0; cursor: pointer;
            background: var(--teal); color: var(--on-teal); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            transition: background .2s, transform .12s;
        }
        .rc-play:hover { background: var(--teal2); }
        .rc-play:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
        .rc-play svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
        .rc-open {
            width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 9px; flex-shrink: 0; cursor: pointer;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-40);
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: border-color .2s, color .2s;
        }
        .rc-open:hover { border-color: rgba(28,183,179,0.5); color: var(--teal2); }
        .rc-open svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
        /* لا تظهر إلا أثناء البثّ */
        .rc-more { max-height: 0; opacity: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height .35s ease, opacity .3s ease, margin-top .35s ease; }
        .rc.is-live .rc-more { max-height: 90px; opacity: 1; margin-top: 0.7rem; }
        .rc-viz { display: block; width: 100%; height: 26px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
        .rc-vol { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .rc-ico {
            width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; cursor: pointer;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-40);
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: border-color .2s, color .2s, transform .12s;
        }
        .rc-ico:hover { border-color: rgba(28,183,179,0.5); color: var(--teal2); }
        .rc-ico:active { transform: scale(0.92); }
        .rc-ico[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #FF8A8A; border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.4); }
        .rc-ico svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
        .rc-range { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
        .rc-pct { width: 26px; text-align: left; font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--ink-40); flex-shrink: 0; }
        .rc-play:focus-visible, .rc-ico:focus-visible, .rc-range:focus-visible, .rc-open:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset: 2px; }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .rc-tile, .rc.is-on .rc-title i { animation: none !important; transform: none !important; }
        }

        /* --- Bulbul (AI assistant) --- */
        .bulbul-card {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem;
            margin-top: 0.9rem; padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.16), rgba(24,24,24,0.5));
            border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.28);
            border-radius: 16px; text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
            position: relative; overflow: hidden;
        }
        .bulbul-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.5);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(124,58,237,0.22);
            text-decoration: none;
        }
        .bulbul-avatar {
            width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 12px; flex-shrink: 0;
            background: #181818; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(124,58,237,0.3);
        }
        .bulbul-avatar img { width: 24px; height: 24px; object-fit: contain; }
        .bulbul-info h4 { color: var(--ink-95); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.15rem; }
        .bulbul-info p { color: var(--ink-40); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 300; }
        .bulbul-badge {
            margin-right: auto; flex-shrink: 0;

        /* --- Layout: primary + grid --- */
        .hub-layout { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 1.5rem; }
        .hub-main {
            flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.6s ease 0.15s forwards;
        }
        .main-portal-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);

        .main-portal-icon {

            margin: 0 auto 1.25rem; font-size: 1.9rem;

        .main-portal-icon .glow {
            position: absolute; width: 95px; height: 95px; border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--sdf-orange); opacity: 0; filter: blur(30px);
            transition: opacity 0.4s ease; z-index: -1;
        }
        .main-portal-card:hover .main-portal-icon { transform: scale(1.1) rotate(3deg); }
        .main-portal-card:hover .main-portal-icon .glow { opacity: 0.25; }
        .main-portal-card h3 {
            font-family: 'Alexandria', 'Rubik', sans-serif;
            color: var(--ink-95); font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
        }
        .main-portal-card p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.66); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 300; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.7; }
        .main-portal-badge {
            display: inline-block; padding: 5px 16px; border-radius: 20px;
            background: rgba(255,152,51,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(255,152,51,0.2);
            color: rgba(255,190,100,0.9); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 500;
        }

        .hub-secondary { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; min-width: 0; }
        .hub-section-label {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 400;
            opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.2s forwards;
        }
        .hub-section-label::after {
            content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(-90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.08));
        }

<script>
(function () {
    var html = document.documentElement;
    var inRange = function () { var w = window.innerWidth; return w >= 768 && w <= 1024 && html.getAttribute('data-layout') === 'vertical'; };
    var keepLarge = function () { if (inRange() && html.getAttribute('data-sidebar-size') !== 'lg') html.setAttribute('data-sidebar-size', 'lg'); };
    keepLarge();
    if (window.MutationObserver) new MutationObserver(keepLarge).observe(html, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-sidebar-size'] });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (!inRange()) return;
        var btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('#topnav-hamburger-icon');
        var overlay = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.vertical-overlay');
        if (btn) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            document.body.classList.toggle('vertical-sidebar-enable');
        } else if (overlay) {
            document.body.classList.remove('vertical-sidebar-enable');
        }
    }, true);
})();
</script>

<script>
function toggleLayout() {
    var current = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-layout');
    if (current === 'horizontal') {
        localStorage.setItem('sdf-layout', 'vertical');
    } else {
        localStorage.setItem('sdf-layout', 'horizontal');
    }
    window.location.reload();
}

function updateLayoutIcon() {
    var current = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-layout');
    var iconEl = document.getElementById('layout-toggle-icon');
    var btnEl = document.getElementById('layout-toggle-btn');
    if (iconEl) {
        iconEl.className = (current === 'horizontal')
            ? 'bx bx-layout fs-22'
            : 'bx bx-grid-alt fs-22';
    }
    if (btnEl) {
        btnEl.title = (current === 'horizontal')
            ? 'Switch to Vertical Menu'
            : 'Switch to Horizontal Menu';
    }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateLayoutIcon);
</script>

                searching: function() { return "جاري البحث..."; }
            },

        $('select:not(.modal select):not(.no-select2):not(.note-btn-group select):not([class*="note-"])').each(function() {
            // Skip if inside summernote
            if ($(this).closest('.note-editor').length === 0) {
                $(this).select2({
                    ...select2Config,
                    placeholder: $(this).find('option:first').text() || 'اختر...'
                });
            }
        });

        // Initialize Select2 for selects inside modals - EXCLUDE Summernote
        $('.modal').on('shown.bs.modal', function() {
            const $modal = $(this);
            $modal.find('select:not(.no-select2)').each(function() {
                // Skip if inside summernote
                if ($(this).closest('.note-editor').length === 0 && !$(this).hasClass('select2-hidden-accessible')) {
                    $(this).select2({
                        ...select2Config,
                        dropdownParent: $modal,
                        placeholder: $(this).find('option:first').text() || 'اختر...'
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        // Destroy Select2 when modal is hidden
        $('.modal').on('hidden.bs.modal', function() {
            $(this).find('select.select2-hidden-accessible').each(function() {
                $(this).select2('destroy');
            });
        });

    });

        .floating-contact-button {
            position: fixed;
            left: 20px;
            bottom: 50px;
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            z-index: 9999;
            border-radius: 50%;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            animation: pulse 2s infinite;
            transition: transform 0.3s;
        }

        .floating-contact-button:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        .floating-contact-button img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0% {
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.7);

            }

            right: 30px;
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            background-color: #007bff;
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: 24px;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: opacity 0.4s, visibility 0.4s, transform 0.3s;
            z-index: 9999;
        }

        .back-to-top.show {
            opacity: 1;

<script>
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item');
    const popup = document.getElementById('imagePopup');
    const mediaContent = document.getElementById('mediaContent');
    const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.popup .close');
    const prevBtn = document.querySelector('.prev-btn');
    const nextBtn = document.querySelector('.next-btn');

    let currentIndex = 0;

    function showItem(index) {
        const item = items[index];
        const type = item.dataset.type || 'image'; // Default to 'image' if no type specified
        const src = item.dataset.src || item.src || item.getAttribute('src');

        mediaContent.innerHTML = '';

        if (type === 'image') {
            const img = document.createElement('img');
            img.src = src;
            img.style.maxWidth = '100%';
            img.style.maxHeight = '100%';
            img.style.objectFit = 'contain';
            mediaContent.appendChild(img);
        } else if (type === 'video') {
            const video = document.createElement('video');
            video.src = src;
            video.controls = true;
            video.autoplay = true;
            mediaContent.appendChild(video);
        } else if (type === 'youtube' || type === 'vimeo') {
            const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
            iframe.src = src;
            iframe.width = '800';
            iframe.height = '450';
            iframe.allow = 'accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture';
            iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
            iframe.style.border = 'none';
            mediaContent.appendChild(iframe);
        }
    }

    items.forEach((item, index) => {
        item.addEventListener('click', () => {
            popup.style.display = 'flex';
            currentIndex = index;
            showItem(currentIndex);
        });
    });

    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        popup.style.display = 'none';
        mediaContent.innerHTML = '';
    });

    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        currentIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + items.length) % items.length; // Previous
        showItem(currentIndex);
    });

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % items.length; // Next
        showItem(currentIndex);
    });

    popup.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === popup) {
            popup.style.display = 'none';
            mediaContent.innerHTML = '';
        }
    });
    
    items.forEach((item, index) => {
        const clickTarget = item.classList.contains('gallery-item') ? item : item.querySelector('.gallery-item');
        
        clickTarget.addEventListener('click', () => {
            popup.style.display = 'flex';
            currentIndex = index;
            showItem(currentIndex);
        });
    });

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // Counter animation function
        function animateCounter(element) {
            const target = parseInt(element.getAttribute('data-countto'));
            const duration = parseInt(element.getAttribute('data-duration')) || 2000;
            const start = 0;
            const increment = target / (duration / 16); // 60fps
            
            let current = start;
            const timer = setInterval(() => {
                current += increment;
                if (current >= target) {
                    clearInterval(timer);
                    current = target;
                }
                element.textContent = Math.floor(current) + (element.textContent.includes('M') ? '' : '');
            }, 16);
        }

        // Initialize counters on page load
        function initCounters() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.counter').forEach(counter => {
                if (!counter.classList.contains('animated')) {
                    animateCounter(counter);
                    counter.classList.add('animated');
                }
            });
        }

        // Initialize on page load
        initCounters();

        // Reset and animate on hover
        document.querySelectorAll('.counter-item').forEach(item => {

<script>
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item');
    const popup = document.getElementById('imagePopup');
    const mediaContent = document.getElementById('mediaContent');
    const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.popup .close');
    const prevBtn = document.querySelector('.prev-btn');
    const nextBtn = document.querySelector('.next-btn');

    let currentIndex = 0;

    function showItem(index) {
        const item = items[index];
        const type = item.dataset.type || 'image'; // Default to 'image' if no type specified
        const src = item.dataset.src || item.src || item.getAttribute('src');

        mediaContent.innerHTML = '';

        if (type === 'image') {
            const img = document.createElement('img');
            img.src = src;
            img.style.maxWidth = '100%';
            img.style.maxHeight = '100%';
            img.style.objectFit = 'contain';
            mediaContent.appendChild(img);
        } else if (type === 'video') {
            const video = document.createElement('video');
            video.src = src;
            video.controls = true;
            video.autoplay = true;
            mediaContent.appendChild(video);
        } else if (type === 'youtube' || type === 'vimeo') {
            const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
            iframe.src = src;
            iframe.width = '800';
            iframe.height = '450';
            iframe.allow = 'accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture';
            iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
            iframe.style.border = 'none';
            mediaContent.appendChild(iframe);
        }
    }

    items.forEach((item, index) => {
        item.addEventListener('click', () => {
            popup.style.display = 'flex';
            currentIndex = index;
            showItem(currentIndex);
        });
    });

    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        popup.style.display = 'none';
        mediaContent.innerHTML = '';
    });

    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        currentIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + items.length) % items.length; // Previous
        showItem(currentIndex);
    });

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % items.length; // Next
        showItem(currentIndex);
    });

    popup.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === popup) {
            popup.style.display = 'none';
            mediaContent.innerHTML = '';
        }
    });
    
    items.forEach((item, index) => {
        const clickTarget = item.classList.contains('gallery-item') ? item : item.querySelector('.gallery-item');
        
        clickTarget.addEventListener('click', () => {
            popup.style.display = 'flex';
            currentIndex = index;
            showItem(currentIndex);
        });
    });

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // Counter animation function
        function animateCounter(element) {
            const target = parseInt(element.getAttribute('data-countto'));
            const duration = parseInt(element.getAttribute('data-duration')) || 2000;
            const start = 0;
            const increment = target / (duration / 16); // 60fps
            
            let current = start;
            const timer = setInterval(() => {
                current += increment;
                if (current >= target) {
                    clearInterval(timer);
                    current = target;
                }
                element.textContent = Math.floor(current) + (element.textContent.includes('M') ? '' : '');
            }, 16);
        }

        // Initialize counters on page load
        function initCounters() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.counter').forEach(counter => {
                if (!counter.classList.contains('animated')) {
                    animateCounter(counter);
                    counter.classList.add('animated');
                }
            });
        }

        // Initialize on page load
        initCounters();

        // Reset and animate on hover
        document.querySelectorAll('.counter-item').forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                const counter = this.querySelector('.counter');
                counter.textContent = '0';
                counter.classList.remove('animated');
                animateCounter(counter);
                counter.classList.add('animated');
            });
        });
    });
</script>

✨ رسالة الإدارة

نحو مستقبل أكثر شمولًا وتمكينًا للأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة البصرية

انطلاقًا من إيماننا الراسخ بأهمية تمكين الأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة البصرية وتعزيز حقوقهم، نواصل العمل في جمعية منتدى غزة لذوي الإعاقة البصرية الخيرية في سبيل تقديم الخدمات والبرامج التي تسهم في دعم الأشخاص المكفوفين وضعاف البصر، وتعزيز قدرتهم على الوصول إلى التعليم والرعاية الصحية والدعم النفسي والاجتماعي والتأهيل، بما يضمن لهم حياة كريمة ومشاركة فاعلة في المجتمع.

وقد حرصنا منذ تأسيس الجمعية على العمل بالشراكة والتعاون مع المؤسسات المحلية والدولية والجهات ذات العلاقة، والاستجابة للاحتياجات المتزايدة للأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة البصرية، لا سيما في ظل الظروف الإنسانية الصعبة التي يعيشها قطاع غزة.

وإذ نؤكد التزامنا بمواصلة العمل لخدمة هذه الفئة، فإننا نثمّن جهود جميع العاملين والمتطوعين والشركاء والداعمين، ونؤمن بأن العمل المشترك والمسؤولية المجتمعية يشكلان أساسًا لبناء مستقبل أكثر شمولًا وإنصافًا للأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة البصرية.

نسأل الله أن يوفقنا جميعًا لما فيه الخير، وأن نستمر في أداء رسالتنا الإنسانية والمجتمعية بكل أمانة ومسؤولية.

برامجنا ومشاريعنا

نعمل على تنفيذ برامج ومشاريع متخصصة تهدف إلى دعم وتمكين الأشخاص المكفوفين وضعاف البصر، وتعزيز حقهم في التعليم والصحة والتأهيل والمشاركة المجتمعية، بما يسهم في بناء حياة أكثر استقلالية وكرامة.

التأهيل والإرشاد الحركي

يهدف إلى دعم الأشخاص المكفوفين وضعاف البصر من خلال خدمات التأهيل والإرشاد الحركي، بما يساعدهم على تطوير مهارات التنقل الآمن والمستقل، واستخدام العصا البيضاء ووسائل الحركة المساعدة، والتعرّف على الطرق والبيئة المحيطة، بما يعزز استقلاليتهم وثقتهم بأنفسهم ويسهم في اندماجهم في المجتمع.

التعليم الشامل والدامج

يهدف إلى دعم حق الأشخاص المكفوفين وضعاف البصر في الحصول على تعليم شامل ودامج، من خلال توفير الدعم التعليمي والوسائل المساندة، وتعزيز قدرات الطلبة وأسرهم والكوادر التعليمية، بما يسهم في تهيئة بيئة تعليمية أكثر وصولًا وإنصافًا، وتعزيز فرص التعلم والمشاركة والاستقلالية.

التأهيل النفسي والاجتماعي

يهدف إلى تقديم الدعم النفسي والاجتماعي للأشخاص المكفوفين وضعاف البصر وأسرهم، من خلال جلسات فردية وجماعية وأنشطة داعمة تساعد على تعزيز الصحة النفسية، والتكيف مع الظروف الصعبة، وبناء القدرة على مواجهة التحديات، بما يسهم في تعزيز اندماجهم ومشاركتهم في المجتمع.

التدريب والتمكين

يهدف إلى تطوير مهارات وقدرات الأشخاص المكفوفين وضعاف البصر من خلال برامج تدريبية وتأهيلية متنوعة، بما يعزز استقلاليتهم وثقتهم بأنفسهم، ويدعم فرصهم في التعليم والعمل والمشاركة الفاعلة في المجتمع.

الرعاية الطبية

يهدف إلى توفير خدمات الرعاية الصحية الأساسية للأشخاص المكفوفين وضعاف البصر، بما يشمل الفحص الطبي، والتوعية الصحية، والعلاج والأدوية، بما يسهم في تحسين صحتهم وجودة حياتهم وتعزيز وصولهم إلى الخدمات الصحية بشكل آمن وميسّر.

البرامج والمشاريع

تصمّم جمعية منتدى التواصل برامجها الاستراتيجية استجابة للاحتياجات المتزايدة للمجتمع الفلسطيني في غزة مع تركيز خاص على الشباب والأطفال والمرأة في مجالات التنمية والتعليم وبناء القدرات، لبناء مجتمع أقوى ومستقبل أفضل

التواصل تنفذ 50 ورشة توعوية حول المشاركة المدنية والسياسية

التواصل تُقدّم حقائب وقرطاسية ووجبات غذائية لــ 400 طفل

تخفيف الفقر والدعم المعيشي
تعرف أكثر

من المجتمع ولدنا .. ولاجله نعمل.

جمعية منتدى التواصل منظمةٌ غير حكومية فلسطينية، تأسست في قطاع غزة عام 1993. على مدى أكثر من ثلاثة عقود، عملنا على تمكين المرأة والشباب والأطفال وكبار السن من خلال برامج التنمية والتعليم والدعم الإنساني. نعمل بروح تطوعية ونابعة من صميم المجتمع، ومسجلون لدى وزارة الداخلية الفلسطينية برقم 7536، وتحركنا قناعة راسخة: لكل إنسان الحق في المشاركة والعطاء والانتماء

تعرف أكثر

آخر المستجدات والفعاليات

تابع معنا آخر الأخبار والأنشطة والفعاليات أولاً بأول، وكن دائماً في قلب الحدث. هنا تجد أبرز المستجدات والتغطيات التي تعكس إنجازاتنا وتأثيرنا على أرض الواقع
